$description: The default contrast, also asserted on every <al-theme> that is not contrast="more" so a nested theme does not inherit a raised value. Sparse by design: theme.color.border.neutral-default has no safe reset (it varies by brand and mode), so it keeps its base value in this mode.

org.primer.llm.usage: Single member (disabled): 0.40 at contrast="normal", raised to 1.00 (tier-1 opacity.100) at contrast="more". Both values are the modes of the contrast axis, tier-2/axis/contrast/normal.json and more.json, emitted as <al-theme> host rules. Legal CSS surface: opacity, on any component signalling a disabled state.
